caveats: Labels come from the same, non-independent jcl_oracle used in development: this tests generalisation of the parser/detector to unseen files, NOT independent ground truth.
Repositories are 'screened by aggregate counts/fragments', never blind.
Few repositories contribute: no repository-level generalisation claim; CIs at file level are cluster-bootstrap over files and are optimistic regarding repository heterogeneity.
Ground-truth positives/negatives follow the oracle: negatives are mostly comment/MSGCLASS edits plus oracle-equivalent fault mutants (see dev adequacy note in results/v2).
